decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 11.2	The application a single storey rear extension to the existing dwelling and demolition of part of the existing store building, as shown on drawing numbers 01, 02, 03, 04, and 05, received 3 October 2005, is recommended for approval as by reason of its size, position and appearance, the extension would comply be sympathetic to the style and form of the original building, and satisfactorily maintain the amenity of adjoining neighbours, and is considered to preserve and enhance the character and appearance of the Grove Park Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: demolition part of existing rear store and erection of single storey rear extension to house (Grove Park Conservation Area)
